bg-primary.$description: Use this for main background of the screens, and dialog boxes, and side sheets

bg-secondary.$description: Use this color for side nav

bg-tertiary.$description: Use this for info callout notification backgrounds

bg-neutral.$description: Use this for badge neutral background

bg-brand.$description: Use this for brand related backgrounds

bg-active.$description: Use this color for active or selected state backgrounds

bg-active-hover.$description: Use this color for hover state of active or selected backgrounds

bg-action-primary.$description: Mainly use for primary button backgrounds

bg-action-primary_hovered.$description: Mainly use for pressed or hover states of primary button backgrounds

bg-action-primary_pressed.$description: Mainly use for pressed or hover states of primary button backgrounds

bg-action-secondary.$description: Use this for swipe button background

bg-action-secondary_hovered.$description: Mainly use for pressed or hover states of secondary button backgrounds

bg-action-secondary_pressed.$description: Mainly use for pressed or hover states of secondary button backgrounds

bg-action-inverse.$description: White call to action on brand

bg-action-destructive.$description: Use this color for destructive buttons

bg-action-destructive_hovered.$description: Use this color for hover state of destructive buttons

bg-action-destructive_pressed.$description: Use this color for pressed state of destructive buttons

bg-success.$description: Use this for success backgrounds. (notification, badge)

bg-success_secondary.$description: Use this for success backgrounds. (notification, badge)

bg-error.$description: Use this for error backgrounds. (notification, badge)

bg-error_secondary.$description: A secondary color for error backgrounds. (notification, badge)

bg-warning.$description: Use this for warning backgrounds. (notification, badge)

bg-warning_secondary.$description: A secondary color for warning backgrounds. (notification, badge)

bg-info.$description: Use this for info backgrounds. (notification, badge)

bg-info_secondary.$description: A secondary color for info backgrounds. (notification, badge)

bg-icons.$description: Use this for icon or default avatar backgrounds

text-primary.$description: Use this for Titles and headings

text-tertiary.$description: Use this for captions, overlines, hints

text-placeholder.$description: Use this for input field placeholder text

text-disabled-on_bg.$description: Use this for disabled text on backgrounds. (buttons, badge, chips)

text-inverse.$description: Use this text color for snackbars and tooltips

text-white_both.$description: Use this text color on brand  backgrounds

text-white_subtle.$description: A secondary text color on brand backgrounds

text-dark_both.$description: Dark grey color for both light and dark modes

text-action.$description: Use this for text links, secondary buttons

text-hovered.$description: Hover text color for text links

border-default.$description: default border color. Can use this for dividers as well

border-strong.$description: Strong version of border color (radio buttons)

border-active.$description: Use for active or selected states. Can use for typing state of input fields.

border-focused.$description: Use this for focus ring, or focused states

fg-secondary.$description: Secondary icon color. (input fields, Close, cheveron)

fg-placeholder.$description: Icon color for input field icons

fg-dark_both.$description: dark icon color for both light and dark modes

fg-white_both.$description: Icons on brand color for both light and dark modes

fg-pressed.$description: Pressed or hover state color for action icons

Alpha-sm.$description: mainly used in the small CTAs inside branded cards

Alpha-light.$description: Use this to show more depth to element's on brand background

Alpha-nav.$description: Used this in bottom navigation backgrounds, and loading overlay

Alpha-border.$description: used for borders of back icon circle
